Ways to give

However you give, it reaches someone.

  • General donation

    Give towards wherever the need is greatest, this edition the party, the health checks, or the foodstuffs.

  • Foodstuffs for a widow

    Last edition, 183 mothers, market women and widows went home with foodstuffs. Help us grow that number.

  • A child's gift

    Edition 1 taught us what it feels like to run short. Help make sure no child at Edition 4 is turned away.

  • Health check supplies

    Blood pressure monitors, gloves and basic supplies for the health station adults rely on.

Every donation goes towards Christmas in the Street and, soon, Project 1,000 Smiles.

Thank you for trusting us with it.
